div.div: Roll out release
In waves, one database at a time, stopping at the first problem.

div.p: Pressing Start rollout writes this list down and nothing else. The practice run happens straight away, on a throwaway copy that is deleted afterwards whatever happens. After that each customer is updated inside their own quiet hours, one at a time; their users are told the evening before and again while it is happening. If anything goes wrong it stops there and waits for you. You can pause, skip a customer or call the whole thing off at any point.

div.div: Leave behind
They stay on the release they are on now.

div.p: The rollout carries on without them. Nothing is undone on their database and nothing breaks — they simply do not get this release until somebody brings them in step, which is the button on the table below.
